C-8.IntentSummary: Native Window-menu items bind tab cycling to Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tabs.cycleForward/Backward menu ids with Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab accelerators; ids removed from RENDERER_ONLY_ALLOWLIST; accelerator pins added.

T-002.Title: Cargo gates for the Rust change

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: cargo check AND cargo test --bin mark -- m009_menu pass (review pass 1 caught two menu unit tests failing under cargo check-only gating: camelCase ids and command-less leaves needed explicit exceptions).

Verification.Command: cargo check -q && cargo test --bin mark -- m009_menu

Review.Findings: Independent agent review: 1 BLOCKER + 2 MINOR + 0 NIT for C-8. Fixed: (1) BLOCKER — two Rust unit tests in m009_menu.rs failed (every_leaf_has_command_or_is_dynamic_submenu: command-less leaves; ids_use_dashed_renderer_convention: camelCase ids); extended both with explicit tabs.cycleForward/Backward exceptions (ids must stay camelCase to match the renderer registry verbatim); gate upgraded from cargo check to cargo test (T-002); 10/10 green. Known gap accepted: (2) boot race — a Ctrl+Tab during webview boot fires the bus event before the editor store registers mt::tabs-cycle-right/left listeners (pre-existing systemic pattern for every bus-based command, not a C-8 regression; closing it belongs to a bootstrap-ipc change). (3) CHANGE_SUMMARY entry added (v1.3.0).

Final gate: VERDICT green. End-to-end dispatch chain verified (native menu ids → main.rs on_menu_event → mt::menu-invoked → menu-bridge id lookup → commands/index.js bus emissions → editor store listeners); taxonomy and native menu both carry the items; accelerator uniqueness pins have no substring false-match. One actionable MINOR fixed post-pass-2: menu-consistency VERSION header bumped to 1.3.0 (parity with LAST_CHANGE). Rust 10/10 stands (no Rust change after pass-2 run).
